design_description: RANK 1 (tier 1: measured). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGGRGPYWMD (3 subs, 3/4 HER2 contacts kept). Binding ddG 0.20 kcal/mol; Lys593 H-bond 3.48 A. 8 liabilities (trastuzumab: 8). enumeration track, 3 subs on non-contact positions, keeps W99/G103/Y105. Best measured binding ddG of the submitted set, 0.20+-0.16 kcal/mol, statistically indistinguishable from wild-type. Epitope recall 4/4; H-bond retained at 3.48 A.

RANK 2 (tier 1: measured). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->SLGSADYAFD (6 subs, 1/4 HER2 contacts kept). Binding ddG 0.42 kcal/mol; Lys593 H-bond 2.51 A. 5 liabilities (trastuzumab: 8). generative track. Best interface H-bond measured (2.51 A, tighter than the wild-type control at 2.63 A). Fewest liabilities of anything we scored, 5 vs 8 for trastuzumab. No F104P or A106W, so it fails independently of the enumerated designs. Epitope recall 4/4.

RANK 3 (tier 1: measured). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGHDGPYWMD (3 subs, 3/4 HER2 contacts kept). Binding ddG 0.50 kcal/mol; Lys593 H-bond 4.07 A. 9 liabilities (trastuzumab: 8). enumeration track. Highest probability of improving on trastuzumab from our sequence model. Epitope recall 4/4; H-bond 4.07 A.

RANK 4 (tier 1: measured). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGPDGPYWMD (3 subs, 3/4 HER2 contacts kept). Binding ddG 0.74 kcal/mol; Lys593 H-bond 3.20 A. 9 liabilities (trastuzumab: 8). enumeration track. H-bond retained at 3.20 A; binding ddG 0.74 kcal/mol, still inside the assay's own replicate spread.

RANK 5 (tier 1: measured). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGGMGPYWMD (3 subs, 3/4 HER2 contacts kept). Binding ddG 0.17 kcal/mol; Lys593 H-bond 7.38 A. 9 liabilities (trastuzumab: 8). enumeration track. Best measured binding ddG of all 18 candidates scored, 0.17+-0.17 kcal/mol. Epitope recall 4/4, though it does not reproduce the specific Lys593 backbone H-bond.

RANK 6 (tier 1: measured). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGGMGPYWMD (3 subs, 3/4 HER2 contacts kept). Binding ddG 0.17 kcal/mol; Lys593 H-bond not folded. 10 liabilities (trastuzumab: 8). enum_3's CDRH3 plus framework S85N/R87T, so the framework pair is the only added variable: a controlled test of a thermostability transfer (Ng et al.). Creates an N-glycosylation sequon NLT at VH85-87, which we measured at 21.1 A from the nearest HER2 atom and 19.4 A from the nearest light chain, so a glycan cannot reach either interface. NO measured Tm; benefit is glycosylation-dependent and unconfirmed. ddG shown is for the CDRH3-only version.

RANK 7 (tier 1: measured). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGGKGPYWMD (3 subs, 3/4 HER2 contacts kept). Binding ddG 0.42 kcal/mol; Lys593 H-bond 6.74 A. 8 liabilities (trastuzumab: 8). enumeration track. Binding ddG 0.42 kcal/mol. Epitope recall 4/4; does not reproduce the Lys593 backbone H-bond.

RANK 8 (tier 1: measured). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGGKGPYWMD (3 subs, 3/4 HER2 contacts kept). Binding ddG 0.42 kcal/mol; Lys593 H-bond not folded. 9 liabilities (trastuzumab: 8). enum_2's CDRH3 plus the same framework pair. Same caveats as fw_WGGMGPYWMD; ranked below it because its CDRH3 has the weaker measured ddG.

RANK 9 (tier 2: model score only, NOT folded or ddG-scored). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WYGDGFYNML (3 subs, 4/4 HER2 contacts kept). P(high binder) 1.000 from logistic regression on 524,346 measured FACS variants (test AUC 0.984, macro-AUC 0.931 within clonotype clusters). Novelty-legal; source: all-four-contacts enumeration. Selected for diversity: the model saturates at the top (24 candidates score 1.000), so among tied scores we take mutually distinct sequences rather than near-duplicates.
